targets.rawSql: WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT count(*) AS "Listings" FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring});

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latest_price.value_num) AS "Median Price" FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring});

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT count(*) AS "New Today" FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring}) AND i.first_seen_at >= date_trunc('day', now());

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT count(*) AS "Price Changes" FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM observations o WHERE o.item_id = i.id AND o.observation_type = 'price_eur') > 1;

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT count(*) AS "Selected Sources" FROM selected_sources;

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT count(*) AS "Latest Fetch Errors" FROM selected_sources ss JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT status FROM fetch_runs WHERE source_id = ss.id ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) last_run ON true WHERE last_run.status <> 'success';

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT count(*)::double precision AS "New Listings" FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(i.first_seen_at);

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT (percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latest_price.value_num))::double precision AS "Median Price" FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(i.first_seen_at);

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT CASE WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_bucuresti_%' THEN 'Bucuresti' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_cluj_%' THEN 'Cluj' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_brasov_%' THEN 'Brasov' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_timisoara_%' THEN 'Timisoara' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_bacau_%' THEN 'Bacau' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_sibiu_%' THEN 'Sibiu' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_iasi_%' THEN 'Iasi' ELSE ss.name END AS city, CASE WHEN ss.id LIKE '%_case_%' THEN 'Case' WHEN ss.id LIKE '%_apartamente_%' THEN 'Apartamente' ELSE 'Other' END AS type, COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', 'unknown') AS area, count(*) AS listings, min(latest_price.value_num) AS min_price, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latest_price.value_num) AS median_price, round(avg(latest_price.value_num)) AS avg_price FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', 'unknown') = 'Unspecified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, listings DESC, city, type, area;

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT CASE WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_bucuresti_%' THEN 'Bucuresti' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_cluj_%' THEN 'Cluj' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_brasov_%' THEN 'Brasov' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_timisoara_%' THEN 'Timisoara' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_bacau_%' THEN 'Bacau' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_sibiu_%' THEN 'Sibiu' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_iasi_%' THEN 'Iasi' ELSE ss.name END || ' ' || CASE WHEN ss.id LIKE '%_case_%' THEN 'Case' WHEN ss.id LIKE '%_apartamente_%' THEN 'Apartamente' ELSE 'Other' END AS source, i.external_id AS id, i.title, i.metadata->'price'->>'display' AS price, COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', 'unknown') AS area, latest_area.value_num AS sqm, CASE COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') WHEN 'true' THEN 'agency' WHEN 'false' THEN 'private' ELSE '' END AS seller, i.first_seen_at, i.canonical_url AS url FROM items i JOIN selected_sources ss ON ss.id = i.source_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'price_eur' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_price ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_num FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'area_sqm' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_area ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT value_text FROM observations WHERE item_id = i.id AND observation_type = 'district' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_district ON true WHERE i.item_type = 'listing' AND latest_price.value_num BETWEEN ${min_price:raw} AND ${max_price:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 0) >= ${min_area:raw} AND COALESCE(latest_area.value_num, 1000000) <= ${max_area:raw} AND (${district:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(latest_district.value_text, i.metadata->>'area_label', i.metadata->'location'->>'district', i.metadata->'location'->>'city', '') ILIKE '%' || ${district:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${seller_business:sqlstring} = 'all' OR COALESCE(i.metadata->'seller'->>'business', '') = ${seller_business:sqlstring}) ORDER BY i.first_seen_at DESC LIMIT 80;

WITH selected_sources AS ( SELECT id, name FROM sources s WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'real_estate' AND s.source_type IN ('html_search', 'html_detail') AND (${city:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_' || ${city:sqlstring} || '_%') AND (${listing_type:sqlstring} = 'all' OR s.id LIKE 'olx_%_' || ${listing_type:sqlstring} || '_%') ) SELECT CASE WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_bucuresti_%' THEN 'Bucuresti' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_cluj_%' THEN 'Cluj' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_brasov_%' THEN 'Brasov' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_timisoara_%' THEN 'Timisoara' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_bacau_%' THEN 'Bacau' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_sibiu_%' THEN 'Sibiu' WHEN ss.id LIKE 'olx_iasi_%' THEN 'Iasi' ELSE ss.name END || ' ' || CASE WHEN ss.id LIKE '%_case_%' THEN 'Case' WHEN ss.id LIKE '%_apartamente_%' THEN 'Apartamente' ELSE 'Other' END AS source, last_run.status, round(extract(epoch from (now() - last_run.finished_at)) / 60)::int AS minutes_ago, last_run.items_found AS found, last_run.items_new AS new, last_run.items_changed AS changed, left(coalesce(last_run.error, ''), 120) AS error FROM selected_sources ss LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT status, started_at, finished_at, items_found, items_new, items_changed, error FROM fetch_runs WHERE source_id = ss.id ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) last_run ON true ORDER BY CASE last_run.status WHEN 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, source;
